verdict.rationale: Phoenix provides the building blocks for CI evals. Dataset evaluators act as test cases forming 'an evaluation harness similar to a unit test suite'. Experiments rerun datasets against app versions to find regressions. A modular Python SDK makes these runs scriptable. However, nothing in the evidence documents running evals inside a CI pipeline or gating a deployment on the results, so a developer would have to build that glue themselves. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or a CLI eval command), pass/fail thresholds or exit codes for gating deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
